blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-Judge Raffy Tulfo questioned on Monday why private Type 5 collectors, particularly Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, were allowed to have so many firearms. He raised the issue during the vice president’s impeachment trial after Maj. Joericson Sangalang of the Philippine National Police Firearms and Explosives Office testified that Duterte had 22 firearms registered and Carpio had 29 — a total of 51. Both were identified as holders of Type 5 Licenses to Own and Possess Firearms. READ: Barbers: SALN disclosure, not value of VP Duterte guns, the issue Tulfo first addressed how […]...
